Hive mother introduced in Aliens.

How Xenomorph Queen connects

  • Work: Aliens — Aliens introduces the Queen as the hive's mother.
  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Ripley fights the Queen to save Newt.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — The Queen lays the eggs that grow a hive.

What is Xenomorph Queen?

The Queen is the immense egg-layer Cameron added, the hive's center Ripley fights in the loader while Newt is the bait.
